query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',s.id,'signalType',s.signal_type,'severity',s.severity,'status',s.status::text,'score',s.score,'version',s.version,'linkedAt',cs.linked_at) ORDER BY cs.linked_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.case_signals cs JOIN core.anomaly_signals s ON s.id=cs.signal_id WHERE cs.case_id=$1
